at-0004.title: Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc
at-0004.content: Use `ledgerly.clock.ensure_utc` to normalize any incoming datetime before comparing or doing arithmetic on it, rather than assuming tz-awareness.

at-0005.title: Money operations accept idempotency_key first
at-0005.content: Every function that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` and check it before any state validation: scan `ledgerly.audit.events()` for a matching key and return the original result (the same record) without reapplying. Pass `idempotency_key` into the `audit.record(...)` call.
